colyseus

colyseus/colyseus-defold/colyseus

Open-source Multiplayer Framework. Run your game servers on Node.js and connect to them via the Defold SDK.

  • GitHub: colyseus/colyseus-defold — pinned to 0.18.3
    1. Pick a release from colyseus/colyseus-defold releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

Variables

Client: ClientConstructor

Creates a client: Client("ws://localhost:2567").

callbacks: CallbacksModule

Returns the schema change callbacks of a room: callbacks(room) or callbacks.get(room).

protocol: { readonly JOIN_ROOM: 10; readonly ERROR: 11; readonly LEAVE_ROOM: 12; readonly ROOM_DATA: 13; readonly ROOM_STATE: 14; readonly ROOM_STATE_PATCH: 15; readonly ROOM_DATA_SCHEMA: 16; readonly ROOM_DATA_BYTES: 17; readonly PING: 18; readonly ROOM_INPUT_RELIABLE: 19; readonly ROOM_INPUT_UNRELIABLE: 20; readonly ROOM_REQUEST: 21; readonly ROOM_RESPONSE: 22; readonly CODE_MASK: 0x1f; readonly MODIFIER_MASK: 0xe0; readonly MODIFIER_TIMED: 0x80; readonly RESPONSE_STATUS: { readonly OK: 0; readonly REJECTED: 1; readonly ERROR: 2; }; readonly HANDSHAKE_SECTION: { readonly INPUT_REFLECTION: 1; readonly INPUT_OPTIONS: 2; }; readonly INPUT_FLAGS: { readonly RENDER_TIME: 1; readonly FIXED_TIMESTEP: 2; readonly PATCH_RATE: 4; readonly SUB_STEPS: 8; readonly RECKON_TIME: 16; }; readonly CLOSE_CODE: { readonly NORMAL_CLOSURE: 1000; readonly GOING_AWAY: 1001; readonly NO_STATUS_RECEIVED: 1005; readonly ABNORMAL_CLOSURE: 1006; readonly CONSENTED: 4000; readonly SERVER_SHUTDOWN: 4001; readonly WITH_ERROR: 4002; readonly FAILED_TO_RECONNECT: 4003; readonly MAY_TRY_RECONNECT: 4010; }; }

The protocol codes the client and the server exchange.

type HTTPCallback = (err: HTTPError | undefined, data: unknown) => void

Parameters

Returns

  • Client

ClientConstructor.select_by_latency(this: void, endpoints: Array<string | ClientSettings>, callback: (err?: string, client?: Client) => void, timeout?: number)

Measures the latency of each endpoint and calls back with a client for the fastest.

Parameters

  • this: void
  • endpoints: Array<string | ClientSettings> — The endpoints to compare, each a URL or its settings.
  • callback: (err?: string, client?: Client) => void — Receives the fastest endpoint's client, or an error when the list is empty or no endpoint responded.
  • timeout?: number — Seconds to wait for each endpoint (default: 1.5).

Room.request(message_type: string | number, payload: unknown, callback: (response: unknown, err: unknown) => void, timeout_ms?: number)

Sends a message and waits for the value the server's handler returns. The callback receives exactly one of response and err: err when the handler rejects or throws, the connection closes first, or no reply arrives in time.

Parameters

  • message_type: string | number — The message type the server's room handles.
  • payload: unknown — The payload, encoded with MessagePack.
  • callback: (response: unknown, err: unknown) => void — Receives the response, or the error.
  • timeout_ms?: number — Milliseconds to wait for the reply (default: 10000).

ReconnectionSettings

ReconnectionSettings.enabled: boolean

Whether the room reconnects after a drop (default: true).

ReconnectionSettings.retry_count: number

The number of the current reconnection attempt.

ReconnectionSettings.max_retries: number

The attempts made before the room gives up and leaves (default: 15).

ReconnectionSettings.delay: number

The base delay backoff scales, in milliseconds (default: 100).

ReconnectionSettings.min_delay: number

The shortest delay between attempts, in milliseconds (default: 100).

ReconnectionSettings.max_delay: number

The longest delay between attempts, in milliseconds (default: 5000).

ReconnectionSettings.min_uptime: number

How long the room must have been joined before a drop reconnects, in milliseconds (default: 5000).

ReconnectionSettings.backoff: (attempt: number, delay: number) => number

Computes the delay before an attempt from its number and delay (default: exponential).

ReconnectionSettings.max_enqueued_messages: number

How many outgoing messages are buffered while disconnected (default: 10).

ReconnectionSettings.enqueued_messages: { data: string; }[]

The outgoing messages buffered while disconnected, sent once reconnected.

ReconnectionSettings.is_reconnecting: boolean

Whether a reconnection is in progress.

ReconnectionToken

ReconnectionToken.room_id: string

The id of the room to rejoin.

ReconnectionToken.reconnection_token: string

The token the server issued when the room was joined.

RoomEvents

RoomEvents<State = unknown>

RoomEvents.join: () => void

The room was joined.

RoomEvents.reconnect: (retry_count: number) => void

The room reconnected after a drop.

RoomEvents.drop: (event: WebSocketEvent) => void

The connection dropped with a code that allows reconnecting, and reconnection starts.

RoomEvents.leave: (event?: WebSocketEvent | { code: number; }) => void

The room was left. Receives the websocket's close data when the server closed the connection, { code } when reconnection gave up or was disabled, and nothing when leave was called on a closed connection.

RoomEvents.error: (error: RoomError | WebSocketEvent) => void

The server sent an error, or the websocket failed.

RoomEvents.statechange: (state: State) => void

The state changed.

InputOptions

InputOptions<Data extends object>

InputOptions.type?: object

The input schema class. Optional when the server room called defineInput().

InputOptions.mode?: "reliable" | "unreliable"

"reliable" (the default) sends one delta per send; "unreliable" sends a ring of the latest deltas, over the same websocket.

InputOptions.history_size?: number

The size of the "unreliable" ring (default: 3).

InputOptions.render_delay?: number

How far in the past this client draws remote entities, in milliseconds.

InputOptions.allow_rewind?: (data: Data) => boolean

Decides, per reliable send, whether the input carries a lag-compensation stamp.

InputHandle

InputHandle<Data extends object = Record<string, unknown>>

InputHandle.render_delay(): number

How far in the past this client draws remote entities, in milliseconds. A lag-compensating server rewinds its targets by this much plus half the round trip.

Returns

  • number

InputHandle.set_render_delay(ms?: number)

Sets how far in the past this client draws remote entities.

Parameters

  • ms?: number — The delay in milliseconds; 0 when omitted or negative.

InputHandle.pending_count(): number

The number of inputs sent but not yet acknowledged.

Returns

  • number

InputHandle.send(): number

Encodes the staged input and sends it. Sends one input on every call while the connection is open, an empty frame when nothing changed.

Returns

  • number — The sequence number assigned to the input, or 0 when nothing was sent.

InputHandle.on_send(listener: (seq: number) => void): () => void

Calls listener with the sequence number at the end of each send.

Parameters

  • listener: (seq: number) => void

Returns

  • () => void — A function that unsubscribes the listener.

InputHandle.reset()

Resets the encoder and the round-trip state, as a reconnection does: the next send transmits a full snapshot.

InputHandle.at(seq: number): Data | undefined

The buffered snapshot of reliable input seq, for replaying it during reconciliation. The instance is reused, so read it right away.

Parameters

  • seq: number

Returns

  • Data | undefined — The snapshot, or undefined when seq is acknowledged, unsent, or aged out.

InputHandle.reckon_time_at(seq: number): number

The server-clock instant, in milliseconds, stamped onto reliable input seq.

Parameters

  • seq: number

Returns

  • number — The instant, or 0 when reckon stamping is off or seq is out of range.

Returns

Calls callback for each item added to the collection field of the root state.

Parameters

  • field: string
  • callback: (value: T, key: K) => void
  • immediate?: boolean — Whether to call it at once for the items already there (default: true).

Returns

  • () => void — A function that removes the callback.
